text.hi: किताब के पेज 17 पर ‘Two Friends’ कहानी पढ़ो: दीपक और भोला जंगल में थे और एक भालू आ गया। फिर सवालों के जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Kitaab ke page 17 par ‘Two Friends’ kahani padho: Deepak aur Bhola jangal mein the aur ek bhaalu aa gaya. Phir sawaalon ke jawab do.
text.en: Read the story ‘Two Friends’ on page 17 of your book: Deepak and Bhola were in a forest when a bear came. Then answer the questions.

steps.question: What happened when Deepak and Bhola were walking through the forest?

questionMeaning.hi: जब दीपक और भोला जंगल से जा रहे थे, तब क्या हुआ?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Jab Deepak aur Bhola jangal se ja rahe the, tab kya hua?

steps.modelAnswer: A bear attacked them when they were walking through the forest.

modelMeaning.hi: जब वे जंगल से जा रहे थे, तब एक भालू ने उन पर हमला किया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Jab woh jangal se ja rahe the, tab ek bhaalu ne un par hamla kiya.

steps.question: What did Deepak do?
steps.modelAnswer: Deepak climbed a tree and sat there.

modelMeaning.hi: दीपक पेड़ पर चढ़कर बैठ गया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Deepak ped par chadhkar baith gaya.

steps.question: What did Bhola do?
options: He fell to the ground and played dead.
steps.answer: He fell to the ground and played dead.
steps.modelAnswer: Bhola fell to the ground and pretended to be dead.

modelMeaning.hi: भोला ज़मीन पर गिरकर मरने का नाटक करने लगा।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bhola zameen par girkar marne ka naatak karne laga.

steps.question: What did the bear do?
options: It sniffed his face, thought he was dead and went away.
steps.answer: It sniffed his face, thought he was dead and went away.
steps.modelAnswer: The bear sniffed Bhola's face, decided he was dead and went away.

modelMeaning.hi: भालू ने भोला का चेहरा सूँघा, सोचा कि वह मर गया है, और चला गया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bhaalu ne Bhola ka chehra soongha, socha ki woh mar gaya hai, aur chala gaya.

steps.question: What did Deepak say to Bhola when the bear had gone?

questionMeaning.hi: भालू के जाने के बाद दीपक ने भोला से क्या कहा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bhaalu ke jaane ke baad Deepak ne Bhola se kya kaha?

options: What did the bear whisper in your ear?
steps.answer: What did the bear whisper in your ear?
steps.modelAnswer: Deepak smiled and said, "What did the bear whisper in your ear?"

modelMeaning.hi: दीपक ने मुस्कुराकर पूछा, ‘भालू ने तुम्हारे कान में क्या कहा?’
modelMeaning.hinglish: Deepak ne muskuraakar poochha, ‘Bhaalu ne tumhare kaan mein kya kaha?’

steps.question: What did Bhola say to him?
options: Someone who deserts his friend in danger is not a friend at all.
steps.answer: Someone who deserts his friend in danger is not a friend at all.
steps.modelAnswer: Bhola said, "Someone who deserts his friend in times of danger is not a friend at all."

modelMeaning.hi: भोला ने कहा, ‘जो मुसीबत में दोस्त को छोड़ दे, वह दोस्त ही नहीं है।’
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bhola ne kaha, ‘Jo museebat mein dost ko chhod de, woh dost hi nahi hai.’

steps.question: Was Deepak a good friend?
options: No, he left Bhola alone in danger.
steps.answer: No, he left Bhola alone in danger.
steps.modelAnswer: No, Deepak was not a good friend because he left Bhola alone in danger.

modelMeaning.hi: नहीं, दीपक अच्छा दोस्त नहीं था क्योंकि उसने मुसीबत में भोला को अकेला छोड़ दिया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Nahi, Deepak achha dost nahi tha kyonki usne museebat mein Bhola ko akela chhod diya.

instruction.hi: शब्दों को उनके मतलब से जोड़ो
instruction.hinglish: Shabdon ko unke matlab se jodo
instruction.en: Match the words with their meanings

pairs.right: to take air into lungs and expel it
to smell by drawing air suddenly through the nose
